title: Chapter 86 Can The Dead Be Resurrected?
content:
Chapter 86 Can The Dead Be Resurrected?

"Senior, please accept my Jiangbei worship!"

Jiang Bei bent down slowly towards Lu Daosheng.

As a martial god, he has always been a being respected by countless people, and he has always looked down on the world and almost never took anyone seriously.

But now, this is the first time he has lowered his identity.

And all of this is because of Lu Daosheng.

Seeing Jiang Bei like this, Yu Qingfeng, who was standing beside him, looked at Jiang Bei with admiration. This prayer was natural.

"alright."

At this time, Lu Daosheng waved his hand indifferently, looked at Jiang Bei and smiled, "Do you still remember what you promised before?"

Hearing this, Jiang Bei grinned.

"Of course, senior, Huangcheng, I, Jiangbei, have joined."

He naturally remembers it.

Joining Huangcheng was not only because of the previous bet, but also because of Lu Daosheng.

He believed that such a powerful force would definitely not be an ordinary force, and there were very likely to be unimaginable resources.

That would be his chance too.

And the basis for all this is because even now that he has reached the Divine Emperor Realm, he still cannot see Lu Daosheng at all.

There is no doubt that Lu Daosheng must be an existence above the Divine Emperor Realm.

Moreover, far above the God Emperor Realm.

Seeing Jiang Bei agreeing with pleasure, Lu Daosheng was very satisfied. This trip was finally in vain.

At this time, Jiang Bei suddenly spoke, "Senior, I wonder if my friend can join Huangcheng?"

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng was stunned and then looked at Yu Qingfeng.

With his eyesight, he naturally saw that Yu Qingfeng was not simple.

Moreover, he has a very high talent and understanding. Logically speaking, he should have broken through the shackles of the Divine Lord Realm and reached the Divine Emperor Realm.

The inner demon.

This guy has a story.

"If your friend is willing, then I will naturally welcome you in Huangcheng."

Lu Daosheng said with a smile.

Hearing this, Jiang Bei looked happy, then turned his head to look at Yu Qingfeng

"Lao Yu, that matter has been so many years since then, let him go with me,"

Before he could say anything, Yu Qingfeng raised his hand to interrupt Jiangbei.

"Jiangbei, needless to say, you know me, and I will be like this in this life."

Yu Qingfeng shook his head, his eyes filled with sourness.

Seeing this, Jiangbei looked complicated.

He will never forget that when he first met Yu Qingfeng, Yu Qingfeng was full of energy.

Holding a feather fan in hand, she is proud of the world.

The two fell in love with each other at first sight and often talked about each other.

Even as a martial god, he could not suppress Yu Qingfeng.

However, it is such a pride in heaven that has become so decadent now.

After a long silence, Jiang Bei suddenly raised his head and then knelt on one knee at Lu Daosheng.

"Senior, please help my friend!"

Seeing this, Yu Qingfeng's eyes were immediately wet, and he hurried forward to support Jiangbei.

"Jiangbei, what you do has nothing to do with you."

However, Jiang Bei said in a deep voice: "I can't watch you sink so much!"

Hearing this, Yu Qingfeng suddenly had nothing to say, and finally he could only sigh helplessly.

On the side, Lu Daosheng frowned slightly and glanced at Yu Qingfeng. Lu Daosheng immediately said, "If you have any difficulties, even if you say it, although I dare not say that I can do everything, most of the things can still be done. .”

If you want money, you need to have money and cultivate yourself.

Is there anything he can't do in this world?

I just said that, but I was just humble.

Hearing Lu Daosheng's words, Jiang Bei suddenly looked happy, "Old Yu, senior has said that, why are you still standing there?"

However, Yu Qingfeng smiled bitterly and then looked up at Lu Daosheng.

"I appreciate your kindness, senior, but I cannot be resurrected by death, I,"

Before he finished speaking, Lu Daosheng said directly: "Who said that people cannot be resurrected by death?"

Hearing this, Yu Qingfeng's pupils shrank suddenly.

"Senior, what did you say?"

Lu Daosheng looked at Yu Qingfeng and said, "Remember, there is nothing in this world that cannot be done. If there is, it means that you are too weak."

Suddenly, Yu Qingfeng was completely stunned, and Lu Daosheng's words kept echoing in his mind.

There is nothing that cannot be done. .

The next moment, Yu Qingfeng knelt down directly at Lu Daosheng with a bang.

"Please help me, senior!"

Yu Qingfeng burst into tears and knocked down suddenly.

I saw that his whole body was trembling slightly.

It is conceivable how excited he is now.

Anyway, he believed this sentence.

Looking at Yu Qingfeng kneeling in front of him at this moment, Lu Daosheng raised his hand slightly, and a gentle force immediately dragged Yu Qingfeng up.

"Of course you can help you, but I can't help you for nothing."

Upon hearing this, Yu Qingfeng hurriedly said, "If senior, I, Yu Qingfeng, will be your person in life and your ghost in death from now on!"

Sure enough, as soon as these words came out, Lu Daosheng smiled directly.

He was very satisfied with this answer.

Yu Qingfeng is still very valuable, not worse than Jiangbei at all.

And the price is also very simple.

It's just a resurrection of a person, it's not difficult.

Although he doesn't know how to do it now.

But, he has a system.

He had asked just now, and the system's answer was yes.

[Serving the host is an honor for the system]

Isn't that just possible?

That's why Lu Daosheng is so confident.

"In that case, there is no problem. Tell me, who do you want to revive?"

Lu Daosheng looked at Yu Qingfeng and said.

Hearing this, Yu Qingfeng was immediately excited and said, "Senior, please follow me."

Then, Lu Daosheng and Jiang Bei followed Yu Qingfeng and left here, left the Wuling Star Domain, and headed towards another powerful star domain.

After the three of them left, countless powerful auras suddenly appeared here.

These people are all strong people from all over the Wuling Star Domain. Most of them are in the God Lord Realm and the God Lord Realm. Each of them is well-known in the outside world.

And the purpose of these people coming here is to come and pay homage to the only God Emperor Realm strongman in their Wuling Star Domain.

Martial God Jiang Bei.

"It seems that the Lord of Martial God has left?"

Looking at the empty ruins where even the Wushen Mountain was blown up, one of them frowned slightly.

Hearing this, the others nodded.

"What should we do now?"

"Let's wait."

One person looked at the ruined Wushen Mountain and said, "There is nothing else to do except wait."

They are very aware of the deterrent power of the God Emperor Realm.

Looking at the known star fields now, there are only a few star fields with God Emperor Realm powerhouses.

And those few are all super star fields that are famous in the world.

Each of them has an extremely terrifying force that rules countless rich star fields around.

As for them, there is no control by those powerful forces.

In fact, strictly speaking, they are very bad here, and those powerful star fields are not even willing to come here.

But at this moment, they have a God Emperor Realm powerhouse here.

And it is a God Emperor Realm Martial God.

They have proved themselves.

Jiangbei has undoubtedly become the light in the hearts of all of them.

At this moment, they suddenly looked up at the void, their expressions slightly condensed.

Seeing that countless hidden auras are quietly approaching the Wuling Star Field.

They knew that they all wanted to find out the truth.

Because in the future, the status of Wuling Star Region will rise sharply, and the surrounding star regions will become precarious, and even face the danger of being annexed.

So the most important thing next is the choice of the God of War Jiangbei.

It is no exaggeration to say that their fate is now in the hands of Jiangbei.
